title: Trade half the search depth for a second assembly structure
hypothesis: Assembly seating requires control structure absent from the current policies, so a second independently generated structure will outperform additional parameter search at equal rollout cost.

prediction.against: baseline: 48-candidate independent search within each frozen D-020 assembly structure
prediction.rationale: A 10-point gain would justify buying structural alternatives rather than doubling numerical depth; both arms receive 48 candidate evaluations per block.

protocol.command: test "${APPROVED_ASSEMBLY_BREADTH:-no}" = yes && gpu run -- python scripts/compare_generation_modes.py --assembly-study breadth-vs-depth --source-decision D-020 --seed 3420 --model gpt-6.1-sol --reasoning-effort high --temperature 1 --out-dir logs/assembly_breadth_s3420
code_changes: scripts/compare_generation_modes.py: add the stated budget-allocation suite using existing single-phase generation, rollout_search and success-then-progress selection; no fitting, lift-aware selector or correction-feedback experiment.

Use the two frozen D-020 structures as separate blocks. Generate one new independent structure per block without showing it the anchor. Depth evaluates 48 candidates from the anchor; breadth evaluates 24 from the anchor and 24 from the new structure. Share the identical first 24 anchor evaluations between arms. Allow at most one validity correction per new structure: two generation calls and at most two correction calls total, with invalid slots retained rather than resampled.

Freeze one 50-case development manifest before generation: probe cases 0-4 and screen/promotion cases 10-39. Each block costs 72 unique candidates times five probe cases plus two winners times 30 screen cases, or 420 episodes. Report both block contrasts and their paired t interval; no difference claim when the interval includes zero and no promotion on ties. Unlike dropped R-023 and ceiling-limited generator comparisons, this changes allocation between structure families and parameter depth on a reproducibly unsolved task. Require per-idea approval and stop the remote allocation afterward.

falsified_by: The upper paired confidence bound for breadth-minus-depth success is below 0.10. A paired interval including zero is inconclusive; the resolving measurement is the same allocation contrast in two additional independent generation blocks.
